scope: Explicit collateral Rebalance for negative USDT in Multi-Assets Mode; debt guard before switching to Single-Asset Mode. Withdrawal submission remains unavailable.

prd.section: USDT出现负余额的情况处理
prd.requirement: User-triggered Rebalance before withdrawal or returning from multi-assets to single-asset mode when USDT is negative.

endpoint.authentication: Existing V3 user/signer/nonce/signature form body; connected EOA signs directly, or existing email embedded wallet. No agent/new wallet creation. chainId 1666; microsecond nonce. Platform signer authorization remains unverified.

response.no_exchange: Empty body only. JSON null / empty object are invalid, not proof of no exchange.

client_policy.eligibility: Fresh explicitly negative USDT walletBalance in Multi-Assets Mode; missing USDT is unknown, not zero.
client_policy.review: Full account balances, wallet and mode; Aster chooses conversion and collateral effect. No amount/rate/fee/quote guessed. No automatic request on entry or read.
client_policy.signatures: Initial mode/account read: 2. Confirmation fresh mode/account: 2; one API POST: 1; separate resulting mode/account read: 2. Typical total 7. Recovery read only: 2.
client_policy.pre_dispatch: Compare all reported financial terms including account summary/assets/positions. Wallet, signing availability, account event (including same timestamp), settings epoch and expiry changes invalidate. Persist public recovery record before dispatch, then recheck.
client_policy.known_reply: Persist response for original wallet even after stop/logout/route exit/provider disposal. Distinguish no-op/reported conversion. Separately read current account before removing record. Reported balance never replaces current account snapshot; nonnegative balance alone does not grant withdrawal/mode-switch eligibility.
client_policy.unknown_reply: Retain original nonce and block new Rebalance/order/config submissions. No retry, resubmission, automatic conversion, deletion or queued continuation. Fresh nonnegative balance cannot prove original request completed.
client_policy.lock_scope: Shared submission/configuration lock, not all mutations (cancellation is outside this lock). Storage not ready/corrupt also blocks new submissions.
client_policy.single_asset_guard: When current mode is multi, read full account in addition to mode/positions; missing or negative USDT blocks single-asset confirmation. Single-to-multi retains existing isolated-position guard.

journal.writes: Serialized, flush to temp and same-directory rename. Startup load before first screen. No temp promotion; corruption/missing original canonical record blocks.
journal.content: Wallet, original nonce, preparedAt, negative pre-request USDT and optional immutable public server response. No signature, secret or executable queue.
journal.failure: Retain returned response in memory on locate/read/write failure and merge after valid reload. Host filesystem tests do not prove mobile power-loss durability.

remaining: No documented original-nonce result lookup: a truly unknown request cannot be resolved safely in-app and retains the block. Requires authoritative platform recovery contract.
Actual withdrawal, deposit, Spot/Futures and main/subaccount transfers remain unavailable.
Aster direct-EOA signer eligibility, actual conversions/rates/costs/collateral and wallets are not verified.
No device tools, APK installation, real wallet/RPC/private/financial requests for this increment; Linux has no iOS build environment.
